   \binom{2024}{1011} - \binom{2024}{1010} = \frac{3}{1013} \binom{2024}{1011}.
   \]
   However, by the definition of binomial coefficients:
   \[
   \binom{n-1}{a-1} = \binom{n-1}{a} \cdot \frac{a}{(n-1)-a+1}.
   \]
   For $n-1 = 2024$ and $a = 1011$:
   \[
   (n-1) - a + 1 = 2024 - 1011 + 1 = 1014.
   \]
   Thus:
   \[
   \binom{2024}{1010} = \frac{1011}{1014} \binom{2024}{1011},
   \]
   which gives:
   \[
   \binom{2024}{1011} - \binom{2024}{1010} = \left(1 - \frac{1011}{1014}\right) \binom{2024}{1011} = \frac{3}{1014} \binom{2024}{1011} = \frac{1}{338} \binom{2024}{1011} \neq \frac{3}{1013} \binom{2024}{1011}.
   \]
